codeBackedAutonomy.finding: The Scheduled Task action waits for the local controller process lifetime.
A local five-second loop imports activated cards, reconciles workers, collects publication results and admits eligible pending or due-retry cards.
A detached Node broker with file output handles owns a non-detached PowerShell runner; no chat request is required to keep these processes running.
Local Codex exec/resume receives a complete prompt once, stdin closes, and approval_policy=never is set. The wrapper waits and writes checkpoints without conversation input.
Verified delivery enters awaiting_po and frees worker capacity; owner review is not a global gate on admitting the next eligible card.

No dependency on an open ChatGPT conversation or Desktop Commander RPC is present in dispatch, reconciliation or publication scheduling. This does not remove the need for the PC, network and the worker service credentials.

materialLimits.finding: Active N94 overlaps the admitted allowedPaths of N77, N58, N73 and N71, including src/store.js. scopesOverlap prevents each from starting while N94 is running or delivering despite maxWorkers=2.

watchdogReason and scopedProgress exclude an entire local card when liveMutation or liveAuthorizationRef is present, or resourceClass is live-mutation. N94 has live authorization, so its budget/idle settings do not currently bound a silent whole-task stall. This is a policy gap, not evidence that the observed N94 worker is stalled.
Automatic intake is limited to activated catalog cards. It does not invent executable cards for every open ledger ticket or revise an already existing blocked/awaiting card automatically.
Quota/auth/network failures use saved retry delays. Environment/external failures and a second implementation failure remain blocked rather than being automatically repaired without a new decision.
IgnoreNew and recurrence can avoid duplicate controllers and recover an exited launcher. They do not restart a still-running hung worker. InteractiveToken requires the configured user logon session.

watchdogFollowUpBoundary.safeObservationalScope: Measure scoped progress and record overdue/stalled observations for live-authorized local cards while preserving the existing stopOwned exclusions.
watchdogFollowUpBoundary.automaticRecoveryRequirement: A later termination/resume change needs exact task/run/PID/birth ownership plus coordinated live-phase/recovery ownership. A lease-free observation alone is not an atomic fence against a worker acquiring the live lease immediately afterward.
watchdogFollowUpBoundary.limitation: Observation alone improves visibility; it must not be represented as automatic stall recovery.

continuityPostObservation.source: Root actual read-only Automations task peek
continuityPostObservation.conclusion: The observed N94 commit preceded the recorded hourly automation wake by about 21 seconds, within the root-reported no-call interval. That later wake does not explain this earlier worker commit. This supplements the bounded continuity evidence; it does not claim continuous 24-hour operation.
